CheckTitle: Ensure Configuration Changes to Roles Built for IT Superusers Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: Fusion pod HCM REST with Basic Auth (ORACLE_FUSION_*): userAccounts with userAccountRoles
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls) for continuous monitoring
Description: Assignments of IT superuser roles such as Application Implementation Consultant should be monitored.
Risk: These roles can fundamentally change application behaviour.
AuditProcedure: Inspect the role's assignments in the Security Console.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Example: control 60024.

Steps: Remove unwanted assignments, or monitor the assigned users' transactions.
Review the affected transactions in Tools > Reports and Analytics, or monitor them continuously with Risk Management Transaction Controls.

Notes: Reads every Fusion user's role assignments from the HCM REST API (as security_platform does). FAIL when active accounts hold Application Implementation Consultant; otherwise lists IT superuser holders and assignments made in the last ROLE_REVIEW_DAYS (default 30) for review. Role patterns can be overridden with SUPERUSER_ROLE_PATTERNS.
